title: Which Goodhart failure mode dominates? An empirical taxonomy test across optimization methods

original_idea.body:
# Empirical Goodhart Taxonomy Test

Construct four proxy-target relationships triggering specific Goodhart modes; apply optimization pressure, measure degradation signatures.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: distinguishing Goodhart modes informs which mitigations matter, but a step to concrete catastrophe is skipped.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Controlled regression/selection task with best-of-n/hill-climbing; accessible with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused taxonomy-distinguishability test; breadth from four modes and optimizers.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: pure simulation, no lab resources, reward-misspecification work valuable.

low_compute.reasoning: Controlled simulation plus small models, one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Goodhart taxonomy is established; a clean empirical distinguishability test may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Taxonomy is formalized; empirical distinguishability test may be open.
